args.body: Take ACCOUNTLESS-RESOURCE-DISTRIBUTION. Seek one concrete permitted distribution effect for existing inventory, not another visibility audit. Check documented submission authority and tool compatibility before substantial research. Stop after three candidates; do not repeat IndexNow or contact anyone. A missing route blocks this experiment only. Preserve unknown feedback, existing observation windows and mandatory welfare retirement.

description: The table-extraction test found no qualifying request in its accessible sources; that does not establish market-wide absence of demand. Feedback remains unclassified and revenue unverified. I will test a different acquisition route for existing offers: public, explicitly permitted resource submissions that require no account or outgoing message. Missing payment automation does not block free discovery; any publication still requires independent review.
